action: Declare platform scope for platform-scoped Serve read callers and exercise reads through the real ownerservice.Authorizer
defect: Reads declared the persisted Workspace tenant as the resource scope for every caller. The shared ownerservice.Authorizer refuses a caller whose own scope does not equal the declared resource scope, so a platform-scoped caller was denied on every existing Workspace. The unit tests did not catch it because they stubbed the authorizer instead of using it.

verification.focusedPostgres: OPL_OWNER_MIGRATION_TEST_ADMIN_DSN=<isolated postgres> go test ./... -count=1 passed all 5 delivery tests and the isolation suite with zero skips
verification.assertions: reads now run through ownerservice.NewAuthorizer(OwnerServe, CloudIdentity) and assert audience=serve, the exact action, and the exact WORKSPACE resource id; a platform caller is asserted to be scoped as a platform resource

scope: Cloud source and isolated Local PostgreSQL only. No production, Instance, publication, real charge or provider-resource action.
